item.edgerunners.sandevistan.tooltip: Wear it in the chest slot, then press V: you move at full speed while time almost freezes around you (20 blocks). 30s cooldown.
item.edgerunners.mantis_blades.tooltip: Fast blades that leave targets bleeding. One blade on each arm. Right-click: retract / deploy.
item.edgerunners.stim.tooltip: Right-click: quick regeneration and absorption. Single use.
message.edgerunners.sandevistan_not_worn: You need to wear the Sandevistan in the chest slot
